title: General.
officialText:
Hydronic piping systems other than ground-source heat pump loop systems shall be tested hydrostatically at one
and one half times the system design operating pressure, but not less than 100 psi (689 kPa). The duration of each test shall be not
less than 2 hours. Ground-source heat pump loop systems shall be tested in accordance with Section 1208. 1.1.
